releaseTitle: Project Workspace, File Manager & Update Log
releaseDescription: Introduces the full-fledged Project Workspace, internal Project File Explorer with safe file and folder operations, project duplication, source ZIP export, favorites and tags, real project statistics, and the permanent application Update Log system.

addedFeatures.title: Dedicated Project Workspace
addedFeatures.description: Central management hub for each project with tabbed sections for Overview, Project Files, and Project Actions.
addedFeatures.technicalNote: Loads strictly via project ID with reactive Room database flow.

addedFeatures.title: Internal Project File Explorer
addedFeatures.description: Real-time navigation through project folders, breadcrumb navigation, and file category filtering.

addedFeatures.title: File & Folder Management
addedFeatures.description: Create new files (.html, .css, .js, .json, .txt) and folders, rename items, and delete with recursive safety confirmation.
addedFeatures.technicalNote: Updates project metadata, total size, and file count after every modification.

addedFeatures.title: Project Duplication & ZIP Export
addedFeatures.description: Clone existing projects into independent sandboxes with unique UUIDs, or export project source files as a ZIP archive via SAF.
addedFeatures.technicalNote: Atomic file copy and streaming zip output without memory spikes.

addedFeatures.title: Project Search, Sorting & Favorites
addedFeatures.description: Live query search, 6-way sorting (Recent, Created, Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Size), Grid/List toggle, and favorite toggles.
addedFeatures.technicalNote: Backed by Room Database v3 schema migration.

addedFeatures.title: Application Update Log System
addedFeatures.description: Permanent in-app release history viewer with expandable cards and categorized release notes.
addedFeatures.technicalNote: Structured JSON asset source paired with What's New version tracking.

improvedFeatures.title: Projects Dashboard Modernization
improvedFeatures.description: Enhanced project cards showing source type badges, entry point indicators, formatted sizes, and real-time statistics banner.

improvedFeatures.title: Version Synchronization
improvedFeatures.description: Installed application version and build number dynamically read from BuildConfig.

securityImprovements.title: Path Traversal & Filename Sanitization
securityImprovements.description: Strict canonical verification prevents directory escapes or arbitrary file manipulation outside the project sandbox.
securityImprovements.technicalNote: Rejects filenames with separators, traversal markers (..), or illegal characters.

releaseDescription: Delivered the native ZIP and HTML import engines, Zip Slip protection, decompression bomb defense quotas, automatic entry point detection, and Room database persistence.

addedFeatures.title: Native ZIP Archive Ingestion
addedFeatures.description: Zero-permission SAF archive extraction into private internal application storage.

addedFeatures.title: Single-File HTML Document Ingestion
addedFeatures.description: Direct HTML file importing with markup structure audit and missing asset link warnings.
addedFeatures.technicalNote: Regex scanning for local css, js, and img tags.

addedFeatures.title: Intelligent HTML Entry Detector
addedFeatures.description: Automatic prioritization of index.html, index.htm, or interactive candidate selection for multi-page archives.

improvedFeatures.title: Project Metadata Sync
improvedFeatures.description: Writes structured project_metadata.json inside project folders alongside SQLite records.

securityImprovements.title: Zip Slip & Zip Bomb Quotas
securityImprovements.description: Enforced canonical destination verification, 100:1 ratio limits, 100MB archive cap, and 250MB extracted cap.

releaseDescription: Initial architectural foundation establishing Clean Architecture, MVVM, Room SQLite database, DataStore preferences, Dark-first M3 theming, and the primary dashboard.

addedFeatures.title: Clean Architecture & Dependency Injection
addedFeatures.description: Modular structure separating core, data, domain, presentation, navigation, and ui packages.

addedFeatures.title: Material 3 Dark-First Interface
addedFeatures.description: Design system built around #0B0D12 background, #6C63FF primary accent, and #20C997 secondary accent.

addedFeatures.title: Commercial Android Builder Dashboard
addedFeatures.description: Hero banner with BUILD AN APP call-to-action, recent projects row, recent builds row, and bottom navigation.

bugFixes.title: BUILD AN APP Navigation
bugFixes.description: Connected hero banner to dedicated Import destination with single-top backstack management.

bugFixes.title: Import Screen Dual Options
bugFixes.description: Ensured Import screen cleanly presents exactly two primary options: Import ZIP and Import HTML.

securityImprovements.title: Private Application Sandbox
securityImprovements.description: All data isolated to internal app-specific storage without requesting dangerous permissions.
